steps.name: Step 1 — Navigate to the pipeline; verify configuration panel + canvas load
Step 2 — Add a custom state variable 'output1' via the STATE panel
Step 3 — Add an LLM node via the canvas "+" menu; verify it appears
Step 4 — SYSTEM: Type already 'Fixed' by default; fill Value
Step 5 — TASK: switch Type to F-String; fill Value
Step 6 — CHAT HISTORY: Type already 'Fixed' by default; fill Value
Step 7 — Set Input to 'input' and Output to the new custom variable
Step 8 — Structured output toggle is unchecked (case's own default)
Step 9 — Save; verify 201 + no console errors
